name: walk
code_version_note: the commit at build time, which precedes the commit that lands this file
generator_rule: top 50 openFDA-labelled drugs (distinct by mva.drugs.names.base_name) in PrimeKG-walk score order; universe = every drug the walk reached, approved when openFDA holds a label for its base name
method: mva.drugs.graph_walk.walk from the card's MONDO disease node over DEFAULT_METAPATHS, damping 1.0 (entry 142, unchanged); every reached drug's base name looked up with mva.drugs.sources.openfda.label through the shared cache; the table contract of docs/iteration4/step-10/README.md

inputs.name: openfda
inputs.sha256_scope: roll-up: sha256 over the sorted sha256 digests of every cached reply body this build read from this API. A public API has no single byte stream to hash; this value is reproducible from the cache and changes when any reply changes.
inputs.known_gap: this API states no release or version in its replies, so the field is null rather than a date copied from the run.

sources.genomic: the gene set of the Bloom syndrome disease node (MONDO:0008876) in PrimeKG; no patient data
sources.clinical: none: the walk starts from the disease identifier, not the HPO terms

limitations: openFDA label presence is the approval proxy (a US label, any indication); a drug whose name openFDA refuses to search is counted not approved
